title: True, False, and Not Even
label: ch:verdad-y-siquiera
canDo: I can weigh what somebody has told me with verdad, falso, acaso, menos and ni siquiera, and say which two Latin twins gave mas and menos.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C324-siquiera: call a claim la verdad or falso, hedge it with acaso, size it with mas o menos, and empty it out with ni siquiera.
